narr: A shortwave moved through Central New York, triggering scattered thunderstorms. Several storms produced torrential rainfall which led to flash flooding. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain fell over the southern part of Broome county in approximately a 3 to 4 hour time span.
ev: Roberts and Pierce Creek Roads were flooded and covered with debris. Roads were impassable.
Multiple creeks were over their banks in the Town of Binghamton. Several roads were flooded, washed out and impassible.
